plugins.name: anime-collection-book
plugins.description: Turn a list of anime names (or a local video library) into a magazine-style PDF collection book: official covers, synopses, staff & cast, watch order, per-season spoiler guides, bookmarks and page footers

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一份番剧名字清单（或本机视频收藏）做成杂志风 PDF 收藏册：官方海报/简介/制作声优/补番顺序/逐季剧透，带书签页脚
